name: Customizable, parametric, frog display stand for single or multiple frogs (up to five)

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a flat, square display base designed to hold a figurine and its corresponding label. It features a thin, low-profile square platform with a small raised rectangular strip along one edge meant to act as a text label plate. The top surface of the main platform is flat and smooth, designed to integrate with external 3D assets such as feet or pedestals.
captions.instruction: Design a modular display stand in OpenSCAD for holding 3D-printed models like frogs. The script should support a configurable number of stands arranged side-by-side, with adjustable parameters for the pedestal height, text plate thickness, text height, and custom label strings for each stand.
captions.factory: The script uses a union of several components to build the display stand. It starts with a base plate created using a 'cube' primitive. It includes a raised text label plate built with a 'cube' and uses the 'write' library to generate custom 3D text labels. An external 'Frog Feet.stl' file is imported and scaled using the 'pedestal' parameter. The entire assembly is replicated side-by-side using conditional 'if' statements based on the 'frogs' count variable, with x-axis translation offsets of 60 units per stand.
